headline: DSJ Keep Learning submits AGM scrutinizer report to the exchange
hook: Scrutinizer report filed for DSJ Keep Learning
summary: DSJ Keep Learning Limited has submitted the official scrutinizer report of its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026, to the stock exchange. This routine corporate filing completes the post-meeting compliance process for the company. Retail investors can review the voting results of the AGM on the exchange portal. The filing has no direct impact on the company's financial fundamentals or stock price.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no immediate impact on share price.
